title: People’s Mañanera August 25
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity’s Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available[here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**House-to-House Healthcare Program: Prevention and Care Delivered Directly to
the Patient 's Home  
**With 20,000 healthcare professionals, the House-to-House Healthcare Program
has provided nearly 25 million consultations, 17.1 million tests, and nearly
900,000 referrals.

**Well-being Pharmacies: Free Medications Closer to the People  
** From September through November, the program will expand to all 24 states
affiliated with the IMSS-Bienestar system. It involves more than 5,500
pharmacies and 1,000 automated dispensers.

**Universal Health Service: Care for Everyone  
** Public health is coming closer to the people. 3.2 million people have
already registered to access care regardless of their insurance status.

**Whoever Governs Mexico Represents Only the People of Mexico  
** President Claudia Sheinbaum announced that she is considering a
constitutional amendment to prevent presidents and governors from holding dual
citizenship: "A Mexican president is Mexican; they do not represent another
country," she said.

**La Derecha Diario: Truth and Connection with the People in Response to
Misinformation  
** Regarding the right-wing La Derecha Diario and its operations in Mexico,
Sheinbaum noted that large sums of money are being invested on social media to
amplify fake news. In response, the President declared that "we champion the
truth and debate, free from hatred."

**Second State of the Nation Report: Directly Informing the People  
** On September 1, Sheinbaum will present her Second State of the Nation
Address and then tour the states to report on projects and results.
